conceptual_change: Implement the Chandelier Exit trailing stop (22-period, 3.0x ATR multiplier) as the primary exit logic for long positions to replace the previously defined static stop-loss, maintaining the same entry signal triggers.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BTC_1h_005) was rejected solely due to an unexecutable identifier. By formalizing the implementation of the Chandelier Exit as the exit strategy, the model can now be tested against the established baseline dataset to determine if dynamic volatility-based stops improve trend capture compared to static parameters.
